purpose: What a checkout of this repository must be able to do, and the values that say it. The gate (scripts/check-checkout-invariants.py) compares the live checkout against this declaration, and scripts/doctor.sh reads the same file to diagnose a checkout that has drifted. One declaration, two readers — a gate and a doctor that disagree are two policies.

why.bare: A bare checkout refuses every command ('this operation must be run in a work tree'), so nothing can be committed and no tree can be judged.
why.hooks_path: Git runs NO hooks when the path does not exist, and it runs them silently. A path that leads nowhere is a gate that reports success because nothing ever asked it a question.
why.ssh_keepalive: Git opens the SSH connection to the remote BEFORE the pre-push hook runs, and the hook takes minutes. Without a keepalive the connection dies in the middle, and the push fails with 141 after the hook already said the tree was clean.
